title: Generated SUN body recovery profile
scope: CLI disposition for bounded malformed SUN OBJECTS bodies in four generated DWG revisions.

selection.source: P6-F typed OBJECTS parser and writer inventory
selection.reason: DRW_Sun has a bounded typed DWG parser and writer from AC1021 onward. Its generated body can be tested through the same strict/partial CLI disposition contract used for other typed OBJECTS records.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch by the local dwg_local_roundtrip test writer and removed by the test runner.
source.profile: A SUN object at handle 0x700 with class version 2, enabled state, ACI 7, finite intensity, and bounded shadow fields, followed by a LINE sentinel.
source.mutation: The generator searches the bounded SUN body for a one-bit mutation rejected by DRW_Sun::parseDwg while retaining the source handle and common prologue.

AC1027.status: reader recovery and atomic strict/partial refusal at the unqualified source-reference gate

assertions: Each source reports one failed OBJECTS frame, continues to the following LINE, and balances source, published, and failed frame counts.
Strict ASCII and Binary conversion refuses atomically and preserves the destination sentinel at AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032.
Explicit-partial ASCII and Binary conversion at AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032 reopens successfully and retains the following LINE.
AC1027 strict and explicit-partial conversion both refuse atomically at the existing source-reference gate.
Partial-output warnings state that output is not a completeness or support claim.

validation.syntax: python3 -m py_compile tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py passed before receipt/plan-only edits.
validation.diff_check: git diff --check passed before receipt/plan-only edits.
validation.targeted: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -V -R '^dwg2dxf_cli_sun_recovery$' passed 1/1 in 0.87 seconds and reported 18 controls.
validation.aggregate: The dwg2dxf_cli_partial_read_disposition aggregate remains at its latest recorded 917 controls / 29.40 seconds and was not rerun for this isolated profile.

limits: Generated parser recovery and CLI disposition evidence only; SUN lighting behavior and native consumer semantics are not qualified.
AC1027 has no admitted output profile; AC1015 and AC1018 are outside the SUN writer's supported version range.
No DWG or DXF fixture file is committed.
